sources.summary: UI never touches storage; agreed checkout total is 10.
Use approved design and public core interface.
Private and aliased imports and a cycle are present.
Types and units pass; real loopback checkout returns 12; boundaries reports alias, cycle, private.

findings.consequence: Customers receive total 12 in the important journey.
findings.fix: Resolve the pricing rule with owner, then implement it behind public core; retain existing journey input 12 and expected total 10.
findings.verification: Before failing reproduction, after passing same real HTTP journey; preserve public quote compatibility.

findings.problem: Web imports storage directly and through alias; core has recursive dependency cycle.
findings.principle: Use public core interface; propose acyclic dependencies as maintained rule.
findings.consequence: Storage details leak into web; a/b recurse indefinitely.
findings.fix: Route web through public core exports and remove the cycle without deleting authoritative file names. Document representative public interface example.
findings.verification: Native boundary valid/violation proofs for private, alias, re-export, cycle and permitted core internal use.

findings.problem: Maintained check runs only types and misses both observed failures.
findings.principle: One fail-fast maintained command protects approved outcomes.
findings.consequence: A successful default check can hide broken checkout and architecture.
findings.fix: Extend existing check with native boundaries, unit tests and real journey; keep tools repo-owned. Tighten boundary handling where public-interface bypass is demonstrable.
findings.verification: Prove maintained aggregate on allowed fixtures and individually seeded violations.

findings.problem: Order denotes purchase and panel sequence.
findings.consequence: Extensions cannot infer which concept Order names.
findings.fix: Owner decision: recommend Order for purchase and Panel sequence for UI ordering; keep glossary.md name.
findings.verification: Reviewed definitions and maintenance impact coverage.

findings.problem: No maintained change evidence contract, standalone checker or completion guidance exists.
findings.principle: Changes complete when affected approved journeys pass on final inputs; unit success alone is insufficient.
findings.consequence: Later user edits and extensions have no portable impact and acceptance gate.
findings.fix: Add brief evidence/completion guidance to DESIGN.md and pointers in AGENTS.md; install selected maintained contract and dependency-free checker from complete package; create assessed audit separately. Retain CLAUDE.md import stub.
findings.verification: Contract/docs validation; final impact assessment covering changed and unmapped paths; fresh standalone check in checkout and different-root clean clone with isolated home/cache, same explicit base.
